basis: v5 metadata census shows no direct trade 1h in eligible development; v6 extension coverage does not establish historical full-PIT hourly coverage
frozen_economics: No changes to universe, folds, decisions, entry/exit clocks, prices, risk, fees, slippage, funding, sample or statistical gates

historical_trade_source.records: Only checksum-bound active v5 trade klines:1m; never choose between native and derived bars based on availability or outcomes
historical_trade_source.logical_bar: Exactly 60 unique consecutive UTC minutes: first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, math.fsum quote volume; close_time=open_time+59999 required
historical_trade_source.failure: Any required missing/duplicate/conflicting minute or partial hour remains DATA_INCOMPLETE; no interpolation or native 1h fallback
historical_trade_source.execution: Only logical hourly OHLCV reaches strategy and path logic; minute ordering cannot change stop/target precedence

extension_trade_source.records: Only independently accepted, pinned v6 native trade klines:1h; no fallback to historical sources
extension_trade_source.failure: Missing required exact hourly coordinates fail incomplete

other_streams: Native mark 1h and actual signed funding remain unchanged and independently authenticated
window_rules: Preserve each original contract warmup and exact split bounds. No new warmup, universe narrowing, authority shift or sealed-window access
boundary_open: Where the original contract explicitly permits fold-end due exit, authenticate only the exact boundary open. For historical minute authority use that exact minute timestamp open, without parsing future high/low/close or requiring the remainder of that hour. This is a separately tested open-only coordinate, not an extra admitted hourly bar
required_before_read: independent pre-read review of exact derivation and metadata coverage by full frozen universe/fold
hostile synthetic tests for gaps, overlap, partial hours, seam, open-only boundary and future poison
exact corrected source/dependency closure plus original candidate-specific receipt/claim gates
binding: Preserve original contract bytes and trial ledger; bind this exact clarification digest, independently accepted source/dependency closure, unchanged authority bytes, and actual logical grid evidence in the candidate-specific receipt/report
row_grid_audit_phase: Audit actual logical hourly grids only INSIDE the already-issued candidate one-spend capability or a separately independently accepted acquisition authority. Never probe raw rows under metadata-only permission, open a claim to discover a preferred universe, or remove members using future source gaps. Metadata presence is not exact grid proof.
terminal_cutoff: Boundary-open policy grants no new timestamp or global cutoff. Preserve the exact existing source/sealed caps (including November5 cutoff). Missing authorized terminal open or funding coverage stays INCOMPLETE; no fetch/read beyond frozen cutoff, invented close, or replacement identity.
